column_source_invalid: Cannot recognize the keyword or formula. Restored the previous source.
column_source_unverified: Syntax recognized. Using {{source}}; {{keys}} are not listed in the schema, so values depend on the image TOML.
column_source_unchanged: Column title saved; the keyword or formula is unchanged.
column_source_help_syntax: Enter an image TOML field such as AE_TAG_REALBVX1000. Formulas start with =; Save adds it if omitted. Numbers, parentheses, arithmetic, abs, log2, min, and max are supported.
column_source_help_validation: Save checks the expression. Unlisted fields are allowed if the image TOML contains them. Missing values or division by 0 display -.
column_source_help_aliases: AE Basic supports Normal_old, Normal_new, BackTar_old, BackTar_new, FLinkTar_old, FLinkTar_new, CWR_old, and CWR_new. Names are case-sensitive; old is the previous value and new is the current value.
column_source_help_delta: =CWR_new - CWR_old: shows Normal|BackTar|FLinkTar ΔCWR in order, rounded to whole numbers.
column_source_help_ev: =log2(CWR_new / CWR_old): shows Normal|BackTar|FLinkTar ΔEV values to 3 decimal places.
column_source_help_ae_gain: AEGain(new) uses =FLinkTar_old / BackTar_old(FLinkTar_new / BackTar_new) to show old(new). Only the value in parentheses changes color.
column_source_help_colors: Above the positive threshold is red; below the negative threshold is blue. Other values keep the default color.
column_source_help_save: Row Save checks the source and restores it if invalid. Complete saves the column settings.
